definitions.explanation: A wedding performed in a Christian church or church-style chapel, with vows, an exchange of rings, and a minister officiating. The most popular wedding style in modern Japan, often chosen regardless of religion.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}ら→彼ら：01802_karera⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{教会式|きょうかいしき}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{結婚|けっこん}→結婚：02514_kekkon⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
{教会式|きょうかいしき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{衣装|いしょう}→衣装：14102_ishou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ウェディングドレス→ウェディングドレス：27343_wedingudoresu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{定番|ていばん}→定番：12265_teiban⟧だ。
examples.english: A wedding dress is the standard attire for a church wedding.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{宗教|しゅうきょう}→宗教：03208_shuukyou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{関係|かんけい}→関係：01298_kankei⟧⟦なく→ない：01118_nai⟧{教会式|きょうかいしき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{選|えら}ぶ→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧⟦カップル→カップル：19414_kappuru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: In Japan, many couples choose a church wedding regardless of their religion.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{教会|きょうかい}→教会：01387_kyoukai⟧ (church) + {式|しき} (ceremony). In Japan this often refers to a Western-style chapel inside a wedding venue rather than an actual church congregation.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {教会式|きょうかいしき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{挙|あ}げる→挙げる：27889_ageru⟧: to hold a church wedding
- {教会式|きょうかいしき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{誓|ちか}い→誓い：14178_chikai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{言葉|ことば}→言葉：02880_kotoba⟧: the vows of a church wedding
- チャペル{式|しき}: chapel-style ceremony (near-synonym, often used by venues)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{神前式|しんぜんしき}→神前式：28943_shinzenshiki⟧: Shinto wedding — performed at a shrine
- ⟦{人前式|じんぜんしき}→人前式：28945_jinzenshiki⟧: secular wedding — non-religious, with guests as witnesses
